How it works

Our Tree Service Process

Four stages, in order, so you always know what happens next and who is doing it.

01

Free Consultation

Call and tell us what you've got — the tree, the location, and what's in the way.

02

On-Site Estimate

We walk the property, check access and hazards, and scope the work to be done.

03

Price & Schedule

You get the number and the date up front. Nothing starts until you approve both.

04

Cut & Clean Up

Work done to standard, debris chipped and hauled, and the site left clean.

Common questions

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does tree trimming or removal cost?

It depends on the size and species of the tree, how close it is to structures or power lines, and how much debris comes out. We look at the job first, give you a written price before anything starts, and you decide from there.

Do you offer free estimates?

Yes. The consultation and on-site estimate are free.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes — California licensed, bonded, and insured under Lic #1030637.

Do you clean up and haul away the debris?

Always. Brush gets chipped, wood gets loaded, and the site gets raked or blown before we pull out. Hauling is included unless you ask us to leave the firewood.

Can you handle palm trees and tall jobs?

Yes. We run bucket trucks and boom lifts for high-reach work, including date and queen palms at commercial properties and apartment complexes.

What areas do you serve?

All of Los Angeles County and Orange County, including Los Angeles, the San Fernando Valley, Glendale, Pasadena, Long Beach, Anaheim, and Irvine.
